Web design in Lawrenceville, GA starts with the city's role. Lawrenceville is the seat of Gwinnett County, incorporated on December 15, 1821, which makes it the second-oldest city in metro Atlanta. It sits about 30 miles northeast of downtown Atlanta near the center of a county that the Census Bureau estimated passed one million residents in 2024, the second Georgia county to do so after Fulton. The businesses here serve the courthouse, the county offices and a population that has grown quickly and become one of the most diverse in the country.

Dominion Web Design Pro builds websites for those businesses from East Texas. Maurice Johnson writes every page by hand, you see a free demo before paying, and the prices are one time: $497, $997 or $1,997.

Gwinnett customers do not all search in the same language

Gwinnett is one of the most diverse counties in the country; Bisnow, reporting on the 2020 census diversity index, placed it eighth nationally. Pleasant Hill Road in Duluth has long been known as a hub for the region's Korean-owned businesses, and Latino, Vietnamese, Chinese, Indian and African American owners run businesses along corridors across the county.

For a business owner, that has a consequence most website advice ignores. A restaurant on Highway 120 might be found by someone typing in English on Monday and in Korean on Tuesday. A contractor in Norcross may get referrals in Spanish and online leads in English. The right answer is rarely a full second website. It is a few decisions made on purpose: which page, if any, gets a second language, whether your business name appears in both scripts, and whether the phone number is one tap away everywhere.

The courthouse economy around downtown Lawrenceville

As county seat, Lawrenceville holds Gwinnett's courts and county government, and a courthouse produces its own economy: attorneys, paralegals, bail bonds, title and escrow companies, process servers, accountants, court interpreters, notaries and the restaurants that feed all of them at lunch.

For these businesses a website does one specific job. Someone looking for a family law attorney or a bail bondsman in Lawrenceville is not browsing. They are having a hard week, they are on a phone, and they call one of the first offices whose site loads quickly and looks like a real practice that will still exist next month.

Fast

A page that opens instantly on a phone in a courthouse hallway.

Plain

What you do, which courts and counties, and who you help, in the first screen.

Reachable

A tap-to-call number on every page and a form that is tested before launch.

Lawrenceville web design for the rest of Gwinnett

Gwinnett's cities include Lawrenceville, Duluth, Norcross, Suwanee, Buford, Snellville, Lilburn, Peachtree Corners, Sugar Hill, Grayson, Dacula and Berkeley Lake, plus large unincorporated areas. Many businesses based in Lawrenceville work across several of them, along SR 316 toward Dacula, north on Buford Drive toward the Mall of Georgia area, or south on Scenic Highway toward Snellville.

That is where city pages earn their place. A pressure washing company or a pediatric dentist that serves five Gwinnett cities can have a page for each, written about that city rather than copied from the last one. The Pro package includes ten of them. Agency starts with keyword research across your whole service area and builds a page for every town and service pair the research says is worth having, usually 30 to 60 pages.

What different Lawrenceville businesses need from a site

Restaurants and shops near the square

Hours that are actually current, a menu or product list that loads as text rather than a blurry photo of a printed sheet, parking directions, and a map. Downtown events send people searching for dinner nearby; the page has to answer before they walk past.

Contractors and home services

A page per job type, the Gwinnett cities you cover, photos of finished work, and a form that asks for the address and the problem so you can quote the right job. Homeowners in this county compare several companies before calling one.

Clinics and family practices

Services, insurance notes, languages spoken by the staff, and a booking or call button that works with one thumb. For a parent new to the area, the languages line alone can decide the call.

Professional offices

Accountants, insurance agents and title companies need a calm, credible site with real names and photos, clear service lists and a simple way to send documents or book a meeting.

We are in East Texas, not Gwinnett

Straight answer on location: Dominion Web Design Pro has no office in Lawrenceville. Maurice Johnson builds every site from Big Sandy in East Texas and delivers it remotely, by link, phone and email.

For building a website, that matters less than it sounds. The conversation about what your business does and who you want calling you works fine over the phone, and you approve every page by link. What we will not do is claim to know Gwinnett better than someone who has worked there for fifteen years. You know your block, your competitors and your customers; our job is to put that into a site that gets found.

If you want someone in your office once a month, hire locally, and we would rather say so now than three weeks in. Otherwise, call (903) 636-7511. Our AI receptionist answers any hour and transfers you to Maurice when you ask about a website preview or ask for him.

Common questions

How much does web design cost in Lawrenceville, GA?

Prices vary a lot across Gwinnett. Dominion Web Design Pro charges $497 for a 5-page Starter site, $997 for Pro with 10 pages and 10 city pages, and $1,997 for Agency, all one time. Hosting, maintenance and updates are $49 a month, or included while you keep the AI agent.

Should my Gwinnett business website be in more than one language?

Sometimes. If a large share of your customers search in Korean, Spanish, Vietnamese or another language, at least your business name, services and phone number should be findable in it. That is usually a few planned decisions rather than a full second site. Raise it at the start of a project, and have any translated page checked by a fluent speaker.

What does a law office near the Lawrenceville courthouse need on its website?

Speed, a plain list of practice areas, the counties and courts you handle, a phone number that is one tap away on every page, and a credible about page with the attorneys' real names and photos. People searching for a lawyer are often in a hard week and call the first office that looks real and loads fast.

Do you build websites for other Gwinnett cities like Duluth, Suwanee or Snellville?

Yes. The work is the same anywhere in the county. If you serve several Gwinnett cities, the Pro package includes ten city pages, each researched and written separately for that town.

Is your company located in Lawrenceville?

No. Dominion Web Design Pro is based in Big Sandy, East Texas, and builds every site remotely. You review the free demo and every page by link, and you can call any hour.

See your website before you pay for it

Give us your business name and what you do, and a demo site gets built for you to look at on your own phone. If you like it, pick a package. If you do not, you have spent nothing but the minute it took to look.
